description: A Polymer web component defining a todo model with data storage, manipulation, and filtering logic.

classes.name: td-model
classes.description: A Polymer custom element that manages a list of todo items with data persistence and filtering.

methods.name: _initializeDefaultTodos
methods.description: Initializes the items array to empty when local storage load is empty.

methods.name: newItem
methods.description: Creates a new todo item with the provided title, trimming whitespace and ignoring empty titles.

methods.name: getCompletedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of completed todo items.

methods.name: getActiveCount
methods.description: Returns the count of active (not completed) todo items.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Checks if a given item matches the specified filter.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes the specified item from the list.

methods.name: clearCompletedItems
methods.description: Removes all completed items from the list.

methods.name: setItemsCompleted
methods.description: Sets the 'completed' status for all items.
